title.en: Honduras weighs restoring ties with Taiwan
title.zh: 宏都拉斯考慮與台灣復交

summary.en: Honduras's new president Nasry Asfura is considering restoring recognition of Taiwan, ending ties with Beijing set up in 2023, and has ordered a review of agreements with China.
summary.zh: 宏都拉斯新任總統阿斯夫拉考慮恢復承認台灣、結束2023年與北京建立的關係，並下令檢討與中國的協議。

question.en: What economic factors influence a country's choice between Taipei and Beijing?
question.zh: 哪些經濟因素會影響一國在台北與北京之間的選擇？

title.en: Lai postpones Eswatini visit, citing pressure
title.zh: 賴清德延後訪問史瓦帝尼，指稱遭施壓

summary.en: In April 2026 President Lai Ching-te postponed a trip to Eswatini, Taiwan's only African ally, saying China pressured African countries.
summary.zh: 2026年4月，賴清德總統延後訪問台灣在非洲唯一邦交國史瓦帝尼，並表示中國向非洲國家施壓。

question.en: How does outside pressure on third countries affect small states' diplomacy?
question.zh: 第三國受到外部施壓，會如何影響小國外交？

summary.en: Paraguayan President Santiago Peña, leader of Taiwan's only South American ally, visited Taiwan in May 2026 and reaffirmed ties.
summary.zh: 台灣在南美洲唯一邦交國巴拉圭的總統潘尼亞於2026年5月訪台，重申雙邊邦誼。

question.en: What does Paraguay gain from ties with Taiwan, given its beef and soy exports?
question.zh: 以牛肉、黃豆出口為主的巴拉圭，與台灣維持邦交能獲得什麼？

text.en: ROC has 70 diplomatic allies, its historical peak
text.zh: 中華民國邦交國達70國，為歷史高峰

text.en: UN Resolution 2758 gives China's seat to the PRC
text.zh: 聯大2758號決議，中國席位由中華人民共和國取得
